description: Let users gift Ark+, Community, or Bundle priced per-currency via Stripe currency_options (matching subscription checkout)

qualityGate.browser: Chrome DevTools MCP + auth bridge (see reference_browser_test_auth_bridge); Google blocks the automated login, so paste a session token + initScript fetch patch

openDecisions.D1_giftPricesPerTier: RESOLVED. USD anchors: Ark+ 6mo=$48/1yr=$80; Community 6mo=$48/1yr=$80; Bundle 6mo=$75/1yr=$130. currency_options for the rest.
openDecisions.D3_bundleGiftEntitlement: A gifted Bundle grants both ark_plus and circle on redemption.
openDecisions.D4_stackingModel: Stack per entitlement axis. Replace single gift_expires_at with ark_plus_gift_expires_at + circle_gift_expires_at; derive tier from live axes. Each gift extends only the axes it covers; same-axis term extends expiry (fromMs), no axis yet starts a term.
openDecisions.D5_paidSubOverlap: RESOLVED (C2, time-based, no dollar credit). When recipient already holds an axis via a live PAID subscription, apply the gift to that axis as subscription TIME: push the sub's paid-through date out by the gift term via `stripe.subscriptions.update(subId, { trial_end: current_period_end + GIFT_TERM_DAYS, proration_behavior: 'none' })`. Effects: (1) current period untouched; at next renewal the card is NOT charged - the gifted window covers it until trial_end, then normal billing resumes; (2) stacking a further gift ADDS to the existing trial_end; (3) on cancel, cancel_at = trial_end (end of gifted coverage), NOT current_period_end, so the gift is not wasted; (4) non-overlapping axes (e.g. Circle in a Bundle gift) still activate as immediate Neon gift terms. Basis B and all dollar-credit math are dropped. Requires `trialing` to be treated as live/entitled everywhere.
openDecisions.D5a_crossBranchCancel: RESOLVED - cancellation-flows is now MERGED into the current branch. CancelFlow (src/components/account/CancelFlow.tsx), retention (server/lib/retention.ts), and cancellation (server/lib/cancellation.ts) are in-branch. The cancel-anchors-to-trial_end change lands here directly (T-020), no cross-branch coordination.
openDecisions.D5b_trialingStatus: trial_end push flips the sub to Stripe status `trialing`. LIVE_MEMBERSHIP_STATUSES, the webhook, and the entitlement resolver must all treat `trialing` as active - audited in T-019.
openDecisions.D6_accountLayout: RESOLVED. Account settings render per-axis entitlement ROWS (one per axis: Ark+, Community), not a single plan card. Each row shows access, source (gift|subscription), and expiry/renewal.
openDecisions.D7_missingAxisCta: RESOLVED. Missing-axis CTA sells the STANDALONE axis subscription (Community-only / Ark+-only) via the existing per-currency CheckoutModal. Only offer axes the user does NOT hold by any source; never offer Bundle while a live gift covers an axis (would double-pay the gifted axis).
openDecisions.D8_expiryConversion: RESOLVED. In-app banner + reminder email via the existing reminder cron (server/lib/feed-reminders.ts / feed-reminder-email.ts, Resend).
openDecisions.D9_bundleConsolidation: RESOLVED (lightweight, folded into expiry flow). No standalone feature. At gift expiry, if the recipient already holds the OTHER axis via a live paid sub, the conversion banner (T-024) and reminder email (T-025) offer a one-click switch-to-Bundle via the in-branch change-tier path (server/routes/stripe/routes.ts) instead of a standalone sub. Otherwise they get the standard standalone conversion CTA.
